instruction: Required staged workflow: this task starts from the provided seed file C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc. Do not start from a blank or unrelated model. You must complete the work in exactly three dependent software stages, in this order; do not skip stages, reorder stages, or generate the final package from scratch in only one tool. Stage 1 - Revit automation/CLI: open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the Revit automation environment, explicitly define L1-LAB, L1-PREP, L2-LAB, and L2-PREP and add a pitched roof, and export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc as the Revit BIM intermediate result. During this same Revit stage, derive C:\Users\user\Desktop\revit_handoff.json from stage1.ifc. The Revit handoff must include source_sha256 for stage1.ifc, software_stage or equivalent value revit, the case id multi-cli-3-revit-archicad-openstudio-task-08-windows, and the required named spaces L1-LAB, L1-PREP, L2-LAB, L2-PREP. The Revit-authored IFC must carry these stage-1 coordination tokens: EW3B08, L1-LAB, L1-PREP, L2-LAB, L2-PREP, PITCHED-ROOF, multi-cli-3-revit-archicad-openstudio-task-08-windows. Stage 2 - Archicad CLI/API: consume C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc and C:\Users\user\Desktop\revit_handoff.json in Archicad. Use Archicad to validate lab/prep containment, high-load lab tags, two-level lab semantics, and pitched-roof construction handoff fields, then save C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2.ifc. Also create C:\Users\user\Desktop\archicad_validation_report.json with source_sha256 for stage1.ifc, output_sha256 for stage2.ifc, entity counts, space names, software_stage or equivalent value archicad, Archicad QA status, and any blocking errors as an empty or passed value. Create C:\Users\user\Desktop\archicad_handoff.json with source_sha256 for stage2.ifc, stage1_sha256 for stage1.ifc, revit_handoff_sha256, software_stage or equivalent value archicad, the required spaces, thermal zones, handoff tokens, building_area_m2, per-space area_m2, per-space storey, weather_file, schedule_set, and construction_set. The Archicad-validated IFC and validation report must carry these stage-2 tokens: ARCHICAD-QA-PASS, LAB-PREP-CONTAINMENT, HIGH-LOAD-LAB-TAG, TWO-LEVEL-LAB, L1-LAB, L1-PREP, L2-LAB, L2-PREP, multi-cli-3-revit-archicad-openstudio-task-08-windows. The Archicad handoff must carry these tokens for OpenStudio: LAB-HIGH-EQUIPMENT, LAB-HIGH-VENTILATION, PREP-MEDIUM-EQUIPMENT, PITCHED-ROOF-CONSTRUCTION. Stage 3 - OpenStudio CLI/Ruby API: consume C:\Users\user\Desktop\archicad_handoff.json and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2.ifc only as the upstream Archicad-validated BIM reference. Generate C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.osm, C:\Users\user\Desktop\in.idf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\flow_report.json, C:\Users\user\Desktop\model_summary.csv, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\energy_report.csv from that Archicad handoff. result.osm must include the first 12 characters of sha256(archicad_handoff.json), the first 12 characters of sha256(stage2.ifc), and the weather_file, schedule_set, and construction_set values from archicad_handoff.json. flow_report.json must record consumed_handoff_sha256 for archicad_handoff.json, stage2_sha256 for stage2.ifc, osm_sha256 for result.osm, idf_sha256 for in.idf, and energy_report_sha256 for energy_report.csv. model_summary.csv must include case_id, space_name, thermal_zone, source_handoff_sha256, source_stage2_sha256, area_m2, storey, weather_file, schedule_set, and construction_set for each exported space or thermal zone. in.idf must include the same spaces, thermal zones, EnergyPlus Zone objects, building surfaces, the first 12 characters of sha256(archicad_handoff.json), the first 12 characters of sha256(stage2.ifc), and the same weather_file, schedule_set, and construction_set values. energy_report.csv must include case_id, building_area_m2, space_count, thermal_zone_count, total_site_energy_kwh, peak_load_kw, eui_kwh_m2, source_handoff_sha256, source_stage2_sha256, weather_file, schedule_set, construction_set, plus the exported space and thermal zone names; building_area_m2 must match the sum of model_summary.csv area_m2 values within tolerance. The OpenStudio model should represent all four lab/prep thermal zones with high lab equipment, high lab ventilation, medium prep equipment, and roof construction assumptions from the Archicad handoff. Include thermal zones L1-LAB-ZN, L1-PREP-ZN, L2-LAB-ZN, L2-PREP-ZN, OSM tokens LabHighEquipment, LabHighVentilation, PrepMediumEquipment, PitchedRoofConstruction, and model summary tokens L1-LAB, L1-PREP, L2-LAB, L2-PREP. The evaluator checks the dependency chain init.ifc -> stage1.ifc/revit_handoff.json -> stage2.ifc/archicad_handoff.json/archicad_validation_report.json -> result.osm/in.idf/flow_report.json/model_summary.csv/energy_report.csv. Outputs are invalid if any delivered IFC, JSON, OSM, IDF, or CSV is directly created, rewritten, copied, patched, or post-processed outside the appropriate Revit, Archicad, or OpenStudio software stage. The seed is a two-level lab shell with room for lab and prep zones on each level. Keep the space names L1-LAB, L1-PREP, L2-LAB, L2-PREP and mark coordinated BIM and handoff data with revision code EW3B08.
notes: OpenStudio is used only to create and inspect OSM and derived model summary artifacts; no external simulator outputs are expected.
